npcs.name: Warden-Captain Fionnbarr
npcs.idle: Howth and Ardagh pay us in silver to keep the mines safe. Lately we're earning it.

npcs.name: Breasal the Stonemason
npcs.idle: My grandfather raised that circle with his own two hands. Now it's walked off.

npcs.name: Grainne
npcs.idle: Cathal went up the mountain to look for silver. The sheevra found him first.

npcs.name: Ranger Odhran
npcs.idle: The sheevra mine the east slopes. They take what they need. Lately that includes people.

npcs.name: Mine-Steward Maeve
npcs.idle: Forty picks, thirty shovels, a dozen lamps. Every one of them stolen this month. Every one.

npcs.name: Sentinel Ailbe
npcs.idle: The road-gang watches us from the trees. We watch them back. It's a very boring war.

npcs.name: Muirne of the Rowan
npcs.idle: Druids who sell the land's own silver to the Azure Order. I taught some of them. I'll unteach them.

npcs.name: Sister Ethna
npcs.idle: Forty-one names on the cairn. I say every one of them every night. Some nights they answer.

npcs.name: Miner Tadhg
npcs.idle: Forty tins. FORTY. That badger eats better than I do.

npcs.name: Foreman Senan
npcs.idle: Keep your head down on this road. They don't miss much, those archers.

npcs.name: Trapper Fiacc
npcs.idle: Big as a pony, that badger. I've set traps for him. He eats the traps.

quests.title: The Road to Howth
quests.offer:
New to Ardagh? It's not much - a mine-steward, a smith and a lot of wind. The Mine-Wardens hold Howth, down the valley, and that's where the work is.

Will you [carry my letter] to Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth? Keep to the road south. The Stone Fields are on your right - don't stop to look at the stones. They look back.
quests.summary: Mine-Steward Maeve in Ardagh has a letter for Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth, down the valley.

steps.goal: Take Maeve's letter to Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth, about 1 km south down the road
steps.say:
From Maeve? 'Spraggons in the tool-sheds again, send help.' She always says that.

You walked down from Ardagh on your own? Good. We've need of anyone who can. Look around Howth - there's work for you, and more out in the valley.

quests.title: Rats in the Stores
quests.offer:
The miners' stores south of town have rat boys in them - not rats, rat BOYS, those little vermin-men from the south fields. They're eating the miners' flour and chewing the lamp-wicks.

Not the Wardens' proper work, but somebody has to. Will you [clear the stores]?
quests.summary: Rat boys have got into Howth's mining stores.

steps.goal: Kill 4 rat boys in the stores, about 80 m south-east of Howth
Search the gnawed sacks in the stores (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Flour everywhere - and in it, glittering, a pinch of pale silver dust. Not Howth silver. Too pale. It glows a little in the dark.

give.name: a pinch of pale silver dust

steps.goal: Report to Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth
steps.say:
Silver dust in the flour? That's... odd. Rat boys don't mine.

Pale, you say. Glows. I've heard old miners talk of silver like that - moon-silver, from deep down where nobody should dig. Probably nothing. Take this.

quests.title: The Sentinel Post
quests.offer:
There's a road-gang camped in the trees just west of this post, and they've started robbing miners on the way to work. I hold the post with three men and a dog.

They've a lookout on a stump who flashes a mirror when we move. Will you [help hold the road]? Take out the youths first, then the lookout - or he'll have them all running.
quests.summary: A road-gang just west of Sentinel Ailbe's post robs miners on their way to work.

steps.goal: Kill 4 villainous youths at the road-gang's camp, about 100 m west of Sentinel Ailbe
Defeat the road-gang lookout at the same camp
steps.text: The lookout drops his mirror. It's silver - pale silver - and on the back is scratched 'from the diggings, for the road'.

steps.goal: Bring the lookout's mirror to Sentinel Ailbe at the sentinel post
steps.say:
Pale silver. A road-gang paid in silver from the diggings?

Somebody up east has more silver than sense. Warden-Captain Fionnbarr down in Howth will want to hear of it. Good work.

default.text: From the post - and from the dog, who likes you.

quests.title: Stinky
quests.offer:
There's a badger up the hill there, north-west - Stinky, we call him. Huge, filthy and clever. He steals our lunch-tins - dozens of them - and carries them off to his sett.

We're hungry and we're furious. Will you [deal with Stinky]? And bring back the tins.
quests.summary: Stinky, a huge and clever badger, steals the miners' lunch-tins. Miner Tadhg wants them back.

steps.goal: Defeat Stinky, the badger, at his sett about 140 m north-west of Miner Tadhg
Search Stinky's sett (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Forty lunch-tins, licked clean. In the bottom of one, a lump of pale silver the size of a thumb - and a miner's name scratched on the lid: Cathal.

steps.goal: Bring the lunch-tins to Miner Tadhg, south-east of Stinky's sett
steps.say:
Cathal's tin. Grainne's man, from Howth - the one the sheevra took.

And moon-silver in it. Whatever the sheevra have found up east, it's coming down the mountain one pinch at a time. Grainne should have this tin.

default.text: Take this. The lads send their thanks - and their lunch.

quests.title: Creeping Stones
quests.offer:
Before you ask about my grandfather's circle - there's worse. The little stones in the fields north of town creep at night. Farmers find walls fallen and furrows filled in.

Will you [catch the stones] at it? Bring me one. A small one.
quests.summary: Small stones creep across the Stone Fields at night, knocking down walls.

steps.goal: Break 4 small walking rocks in the Stone Fields, about 330 m north-west of Howth
Pick up a still stone in the Stone Fields (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: A small stone, warm as a hand. In a crack on its underside, a fleck of pale silver, glowing.

steps.goal: Bring the stone to Breasal the Stonemason in Howth
steps.say:
Warm. Stones aren't warm.

And what's that in the crack? Silver? ...Grandfather used to say the old stones had hearts. I thought he meant it nicely.

quests.title: The Stone-Singer
quests.offer:
The old stories say Seireadan sings to the stones. A creature of the west fields, older than Howth. If anything is waking them, it's that song.

Will you [silence Seireadan]? He haunts the far west, past the lough.
quests.summary: Seireadan, an old creature of the west, sings to the stones - and they've started to answer.

steps.goal: Defeat Seireadan, the stone-singer, about 470 m west of Howth
steps.text: Seireadan falls silent, and in the quiet you hear it: the stones are still singing, without him. Something else is calling them now.

steps.goal: Return to Breasal the Stonemason in Howth
steps.say:
Still singing? Without him?

Then it isn't Seireadan. It's something they're singing TO. Gods. My grandfather's circle walked off last week. I didn't want to believe it was all one thing.

quests.title: The Walking Stones
quests.offer:
My grandfather's stone circle, up on the northern slopes - every stone of it got up and walked off last week. Seven standing stones, gone. Left their sockets like pulled teeth.

The little walking rocks have been seen west of here. Stones don't walk on their own. Someone woke them. Will you [find the stones]?
quests.summary: Breasal's grandfather's stone circle got up and walked away. Someone woke the stones.

steps.goal: Go to the empty stone circle in the north, about 300 m south-west of Ardagh
steps.text: Seven sockets in the turf, deep and fresh. Tracks - round, heavy, rolling tracks - going south-west.

steps.goal: Break 6 walking stones in the Stone Fields, about 400 m north of Howth
steps.text: They topple, and lie still, and are only stones. But there are fresh ogham marks on every one.

steps.goal: Search where the stones gathered, a little north in the Stone Fields (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: An ogham stick: 'WAKE AND WALK, IN THE NAME OF GRUGOCH.' Spraggon work - bad spelling and all. Tied to it, a thread of pale silver wire.

steps.goal: Kill 5 spraggonolls at the north end of the Stone Fields
Defeat the spraggon chief, about 550 m north of Howth
steps.text: Grugoch sits down hard. 'Fine! FINE! The silver told me to! It sings! They wanted to see the lough anyway! They TOLD me!'

stages.name: Chief Grugoch
stages.announce: A spraggon in a crown of pebbles hops onto a boulder. 'My stones! I woke them! They're MINE!'

steps.goal: Bring the ogham stick to Breasal the Stonemason in Howth
steps.say:
The spraggon said the stones WANTED to walk? To see the lough? And the silver told him to?

Grandfather used to say they were restless. I thought it was a story.

With that stick I can [put them to sleep] - back in the circle, standing, forever. Or I could [let them walk] to the lough, and grandfather's circle stands empty. Gods. I'm a mason. I didn't think I'd have to ask stones what they want.

options.say: Back in the circle, then. Sleep well, old ones. You've a job to do.
Then I'll carve 'walk on' on the stick and leave it at the circle. ...They'll be at the lough by midsummer, I'd say. Slow walkers.

quests.title: The Night Field
quests.offer:
Breasal brought me his warm stone. I know what's in it. Moon-silver - silver from the deep vein under the east mountain, sealed by the old druids a thousand years ago. It sings, and the stones answer.

Someone has opened the vein. Help me pry the silver out of the stone ring in the fields tonight - it will fight. Will you [stand the night]? Bring a friend.
quests.summary: Moon-silver from a sealed vein is waking the stones. Muirne of the Rowan means to pry it out of a stone ring at night.

steps.goal: Go to the stone ring at the north end of the Stone Fields, about 550 m south-west of Ardagh
steps.text: A ring of small stones, rocking gently in place like sleepers. In the middle one, a pale light pulses.

steps.goal: Keep Muirne alive while she pries the silver out of the stones
steps.text: The silver comes free with a sound like a bell. Every stone in the ring stops - and the biggest stands up.

stages.name: Keep Muirne safe
stages.announce: Muirne kneels and starts to work. The stones around you begin to grind.
stages.thanks: Got it. Got it! Gods, it's cold.

stages.name: the Ring-Warden
stages.announce: The ring's oldest stone heaves itself out of the turf. It wants its silver back.

steps.goal: Speak to Muirne at the stone ring
steps.say:
There. Feel it - cold, and singing. This came out of the deep vein, and somebody's selling it by the cartload.

The sheevra dig in the east. The rogue druids in the hollow have been very rich lately. I'll find out which. Thank you.

quests.title: Stolen Tools
quests.offer:
Forty picks. Thirty shovels. A dozen lamps. All stolen this month, all from Ardagh's tool-sheds, all at night.

The spraggons. I know it's the spraggons - they leave droppings everywhere. Their cache is in the west burrows. Will you [find our tools]?
quests.summary: Ardagh's mining tools are being stolen by spraggons.

steps.goal: Kill 4 spraggonites at their tool cache, about 550 m west of Ardagh
Search the tool cache (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Picks stamped HOWTH, shovels stamped ARDAGH - and a tally scratched on a board: so many picks to 'the shiny men east', so many lamps.

steps.goal: Bring the stolen picks to Mine-Steward Maeve in Ardagh
steps.say:
'The shiny men east'? The sheevra - in their silver mail.

So the spraggons steal our tools and sell them to the sheevra, and the sheevra dig our silver with our picks. That's almost clever. I hate it.

quests.title: The Spraggon Tinker
quests.offer:
Somebody among the spraggons can count, and trade, and keep a tally. Spraggons can't do any of that. Somebody's running them.

There's a tinker at the den mouth - bigger than the rest, with goggles. Will you [catch the tinker]?
quests.summary: A spraggon tinker at the den mouth runs the tool trade with the sheevra.

steps.goal: Defeat the spraggon tinker at the den mouth, about 720 m north-west of Howth
steps.text: The tinker falls in a clatter of gears. His ledger lists every pick and lamp - paid for in pale silver dust.

steps.goal: Bring the tinker's ledger to Mine-Steward Maeve in Ardagh
steps.say:
Paid in silver dust. That pale stuff the Wardens keep finding.

The tinker's just a trader. The den answers to two bosses - one called, I'm not joking, Boss. The other's Sargoth.

quests.title: Boss
quests.offer:
Boss. A spraggon who named himself Boss. He wears a crown of nails and sits on a throne of stolen buckets in the northern burrow.

He takes his cut of every pick the den sells. Will you [depose Boss]?
quests.summary: Boss, the spraggon who named himself Boss, takes a cut of the den's stolen-tool trade.

steps.goal: Defeat Boss beside the spraggon tool cache, about 540 m west of Ardagh
steps.text: Boss topples off his bucket-throne. His crown rolls into the dirt. Under the throne, a sack of pale silver dust.

steps.goal: Bring Boss's crown to Mine-Steward Maeve in Ardagh
steps.say:
A crown of NAILS. Our nails.

One more. Sargoth, down at the den mouth. The big one. You'll want friends.

quests.title: Sargoth
quests.offer:
Sargoth rules the den mouth. Every spraggon in the west answers to him, and every stolen pick passes him on the way to the sheevra.

Bring friends - lots of them - and [end the den's trade].
quests.summary: Sargoth rules the Spraggon Den's mouth, and every stolen tool passes him on its way to the sheevra.

steps.goal: Kill 4 spraggonilts at the den mouth, about 720 m north-west of Howth
Defeat Sargoth, just inside the den mouth
steps.text: Sargoth falls with a crash that shakes the burrow. Somewhere deep in the den, a lot of spraggons start packing.

steps.goal: Report to Mine-Steward Maeve in Ardagh
steps.say:
The den's broken. The tools are coming home in barrow-loads.

The Wardens say we should [melt the tools] the sheevra touched and forge new ones, clean. The miners say [keep the tools] - a pick's a pick, and silver's silver. What do you think?

options.say: Melt them. New picks, clean hands. The smith will be pleased.
Keep them. Miners are practical people. A pick's a pick.

quests.title: Archers on the Spoil Heaps
quests.offer:
The sheevra have archers on the spoil heaps just up the road there. They shoot anything that walks - miners, Wardens, a cow last week. Nothing's moved on this road in days.

Will you [clear the spoil heaps]? Bring me one of their arrows. I want to see what they're using.
quests.summary: Sheevra archers on the spoil heaps shoot at anything on the mine road.

steps.goal: Kill 5 sheevra archers on the spoil heaps, about 90 m north-east of Foreman Senan
Bring the sheevra arrow to Foreman Senan on the mine road
steps.say:
Moon-silver arrowheads. They're tipping ARROWS with it.

They must have a mountain of the stuff. Grainne in Howth's been asking for help - her Cathal's one of the men they took to dig it.

quests.title: The Sheevra's Miners
quests.offer:
My husband Cathal went up the eastern slopes looking for silver. He found the sheevra instead - or they found him. Ranger [Odhran] says they've been taking men to dig for them.

Cathal's no fighter. He's barely a miner. Will you [bring him home]?

topics.Odhran: The ranger. He's by the stables. He's been watching the east slopes all season.

quests.summary: The sheevra have been taking men to work their silver mines. Grainne's husband is one of them.

steps.goal: Ask Ranger Odhran in Howth about the sheevra
steps.say: They've archers on the ridge who'll shoot anything that walks. Get past those and you'll find the miners' tracks east, deep into the hills - the sheevra work their slaves at the far [diggings].

steps.goal: Kill 5 sheevra archers on the ridge, about 650 m north-east of Howth
Search the ridge where the archers stood (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: A pick with 'CATHAL' scratched on the handle, snapped in two. Chain-marks in the dirt, heading east.

steps.goal: Find the sheevra's far diggings, about 840 m east of Howth
steps.text: A raw hole in the hillside. Men in chains, hauling rock. Sheevra overseers with whips.

steps.goal: Free the captive miners at the diggings
steps.text: The sheevra break and run. The miners drop their chains and sit down, laughing and crying.

stages.name: Keep Cathal alive
stages.announce: You strike the first chain off, and every sheevra in the diggings comes running.
stages.thanks: Is it over? Is it really?

stages.name: Chieftain Morc
stages.announce: A sheevra in a silver helm. 'My diggers. My silver. MINE.'

steps.goal: Talk to Cathal, the freed miner
steps.say:
I found it, you know. The vein. That's why they kept me. Silver like nobody's seen since my grandfather's day - and below it, the pale stuff, the moon-silver, singing in the rock. Enough to make Grainne and me rich ten times over.

If we [claim the vein], the sheevra will come back for it. Every year. We'd need guards and walls and we'd never sleep easy. Or we [collapse the mine], and go home poor, and nobody fights over it ever again.

options.say: Then I'll stake it today. Grainne will kill me. And then she'll buy a cow. Ten cows.
...Help me with the props. There. Listen to it go. ...Let's go home.

steps.goal: Return to Grainne in Howth
steps.say:
He's home, and he's RICH, and he's hired six men with spears to guard a hole in a hill.

The sheevra will come back. He knows. I know. I married a fool. A rich fool. Here - take a share.

steps.goal: Return to Grainne in Howth
steps.say:
He brought the mountain down on it. All that silver, and he buried it.

And then he came home and slept for two days, and when he woke up he asked me what was for supper, like nothing happened. I've never loved him more.

quests.title: Scar-Nose
quests.offer:
The sheevra keep a war-badger - Scar-nose, they call him - big as a pony and trained to run down any miner who escapes. He hunts these pastures now, just east of here.

I found what was left of one of those miners last week. Will you [hunt Scar-nose]?
quests.summary: Scar-nose, the sheevra's war-badger, runs down escaped miners on the High Pastures.

steps.goal: Defeat Scar-nose, who prowls about 90 m east of Trapper Fiacc
steps.text: Scar-nose goes down at last. His collar is sheevra silver, stamped with a chieftain's mark: Dergal.

steps.goal: Bring Scar-nose's collar to Trapper Fiacc on the High Pastures
steps.say:
Dergal's mark. Chieftain Dergal - he holds the main working in the east, they say. His overseer, Camlin, runs the diggings.

Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth will want this collar. Tell him the pastures are safe to cross again.

default.text: Take this. The pastures thank you.

quests.title: The Overseer
quests.offer:
Overseer Camlin works the slaves at the far diggings and keeps the sheevra's tallies. Cathal says he goes down to the workings every evening to count the silver.

Catch him at the workings, away from Dergal's huts. Will you [catch Camlin]? Bring me his tallies.
quests.summary: Overseer Camlin keeps the sheevra's silver tallies and visits the far workings every evening.

steps.goal: Go to the far mine workings, about 820 m east of Howth
steps.text: Sheevra miners stacking pale ore by lamplight - and an overseer in silver with a whip and a tally-board.

steps.goal: Defeat Overseer Camlin at the far workings
steps.text: Camlin falls, wounded, and crawls off into the dark toward the main working. His tally-board stays where it fell.

stages.name: Overseer Camlin
stages.objective: Defeat Overseer Camlin at the far workings
stages.announce: 'Howth scum? At MY workings?' The overseer snaps his whip.

steps.goal: Bring the overseer's tally to Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth
steps.say:
'Moon-silver: forty carts to the druids of the hollow. Paid in blue beads.'

Blue beads. That's the Azure Order's coin - they burn men in wicker over in Connacht. What does a fire-cult want with forty carts of silver?

quests.title: Chieftain Dergal
quests.offer:
Dergal is mustering his war-band at the lake camp below the mines, to march on Howth before we march on him.

We hit him there, in the open, before he's ready. Every Warden I have, and every friend you have. Will you [break the muster]?
quests.summary: Chieftain Dergal is mustering the sheevra war-band at the lake camp to march on Howth.

steps.goal: Kill 4 sheevra swordsmen at the lake camp, about 525 m east of Howth
Defeat Chieftain Dergal when he comes to the lake camp
steps.text: Dergal staggers, roars, and is dragged off by his guards toward the main working, bleeding. The muster breaks.

stages.name: Chieftain Dergal
stages.objective: Defeat Chieftain Dergal when he comes to the lake camp
stages.announce: Chieftain Dergal in silver mail: 'Howth's diggers come to ME? Good. Saves me the walk.'

steps.goal: Return to Warden-Captain Fionnbarr in Howth
steps.say:
He ran. Dragged off by his own guards, bleeding like a stuck pig.

The muster's broken, the valley's with us. When Howth's ready, we take the mine itself. Take this - and get some sleep.

quests.title: The Gray Miners
quests.offer:
The gray spectres at the Fallen Camp are the miners who died when the east shaft fell in. Forty-one of them. They walk the tents still, looking for the way out.

Something keeps them from resting. Will you [go to the camp] and find out what?
quests.summary: The gray spectres of the Fallen Camp are miners who died in a collapse. Something keeps them from resting.

steps.goal: Go to the Fallen Camp, about 430 m south-east of the Miners' Cairn
steps.text: Tents still standing, rotted grey. Lamps still lit, burning cold blue. Gray shapes at the tent-flaps, turning towards you.

steps.goal: Kill 5 gray spectres among the miners' tents at the Fallen Camp
Search the foreman's tent at the Fallen Camp (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: The last entry, in a shaking hand: 'Broke through below the old seal. Pale silver, singing. Then the deep wind came up the shaft.'

steps.goal: Bring the foreman's tally-book to Sister Ethna at the Miners' Cairn
steps.say:
'Below the old seal.' They broke the druids' seal.

So the collapse wasn't an accident. They opened something, and it closed the mountain on them. Gods keep them.

default.text: Take this. And say their names, if you can.

quests.title: Bones of the Camp
quests.offer:
The miners' bones walk with the spectres - you saw them. They want burying, and the spectres won't rest until they are.

Gather what you can, and then [find the seal] at the collapsed shaft. If the druids' seal is broken, I want to see it.
quests.summary: The Fallen Camp's dead want burying, and Sister Ethna wants to see the broken seal.

steps.goal: Kill 5 skeletal pawns (the miners' bones) among the tents at the Fallen Camp
Search the collapsed shaft, about 135 m south-east of the Miners' Cairn (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: A great slab carved with ogham, split clean down the middle. Picks did that. On the far side, cold light and a smell of storms.

steps.goal: Return to Sister Ethna at the Miners' Cairn
steps.say:
Split by picks. Sheevra picks.

The bones are buried; forty-one names said. But that seal held something in, and it's out now. The deamhan on the heights - they came up that shaft.

quests.title: Up the Shaft
quests.offer:
The deamhan pour out of the collapsed shaft every night, stone and storm. The Rowan say they guard what's below - whatever the sheevra woke.

Will you [hold the shaft] long enough for me to see down it?
quests.summary: Deamhan pour out of the collapsed shaft. Sister Ethna wants to see what they guard.

steps.goal: Kill 4 deamhan creig at the collapsed shaft, about 135 m south-east of the Miners' Cairn
Kill 2 mountain mephits at the collapsed shaft
Return to Sister Ethna at the Miners' Cairn
steps.say:
I looked. I wish I hadn't.

Down in the vein, something big, wrapped round the moon-silver like a dragon round gold. It's been feeding on it. The sheevra dig AROUND it. It lets them, because it's growing.

default.text: Take this. You'll need it for what comes next.

quests.title: The Thing in the Vein
quests.offer:
It's growing, and the mountain groans with it. If it keeps feeding, it'll come up the shaft and down the valley, and Howth will be a memory.

Bring everyone you can. Go down to the sealed vein and [kill the Thing]. Then we seal it properly - or we don't.
quests.summary: A deamhan lord, the Thing in the Vein, feeds on the moon-silver at the bottom of the broken seal.

steps.goal: Go down to the sealed vein, about 220 m south-east of the Miners' Cairn
steps.text: A cavern of pale light. Moon-silver everywhere, veins of it singing in the walls - and coiled round the brightest seam, something vast and stony that opens its eyes.

steps.goal: Kill the Thing in the Vein
steps.text: The Thing in the Vein shudders and goes still, and the singing in the walls drops to a murmur. The gray lights at the Fallen Camp go out, one by one.

steps.goal: Return to Sister Ethna at the Miners' Cairn
steps.say:
The Thing is dead. The miners are resting - I felt them go.

The vein's still there. I can [seal the vein] again, the old way, and the moon-silver sleeps for another thousand years. Or Howth can [mine the vein] - carefully, with the Rowan watching - and be rich. The Rowan say seal it. The Wardens say mine it. You went down there. You choose.

options.say: Sealed, then. Sleep. All of you, sleep.
Carefully, then. Very carefully. And the Rowan watch every cart.

sealed.text: Take these, with the Rowan's thanks and forty-one others'.

mined.text: Take these, with the Rowan's thanks and forty-one others'.

quests.title: The Druid Stones
quests.offer:
Druids I trained are in the hollow south of here, at the old stones, working moon-silver into something. They don't answer my letters.

Go and see. If they fight, [bring their satchels] - I want to know what they're making.
quests.summary: Rogue druids in the hollow are working moon-silver at the old stones.

steps.goal: Kill 5 rogue druids at the druid stones, about 320 m east of Muirne's post
Bring the druids' satchel to Muirne of the Rowan, about 350 m south of Howth
steps.say:
Moon-silver, ground to dust. And blue-glass beads - the Azure Order's coin.

They're grinding it fine enough to burn. Fire that burns silver... Nictol would know. He was the best of us once. He lives alone in the south-west now, and he's gone strange.

quests.title: Nictol the Unkempt
quests.offer:
Nictol taught me the rowan rites. Now he lives in a hut of bones in the south-west and talks to the moon.

He won't talk to me. He might talk to you - or he might fight. Either way, [find what Nictol knows].
quests.summary: Nictol the Unkempt, once the best of the Rowan, lives alone in the south-west and has gone strange.

steps.goal: Defeat Nictol the Unkempt at his hut, about 400 m west of Muirne
steps.text: Nictol falls back against his hut, laughing and weeping. 'Moon-silver, moon-silver, burns blue, burns BLUE!'

steps.goal: Search Nictol's hut (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Letters from 'the Broker': 'Grind it, and we'll carry it. The Voice of the Azure pays in beads. Silver fire opens the gate in Connacht faster than wood.'

steps.goal: Bring Nictol's letters to Muirne of the Rowan, about 350 m south of Howth
steps.say:
'Silver fire opens the gate in Connacht faster than wood.'

The Voice of the Azure. In Connacht they burn men in wicker to feed a demon gate - Druidess Eabha writes of it. And our silver is making their fires burn hotter. The Broker. I want the Broker.

quests.title: The Moon-Silver Broker
quests.offer:
The Broker keeps a camp in the far south of the hollow, with druids to guard him and a cart-road to Connacht.

Bring friends. [Stop the Broker], and every cart of moon-silver stops with him.
quests.summary: The Moon-Silver Broker sends moon-silver from the sheevra to the Azure Order in Connacht.

steps.goal: Defeat the Moon-Silver Broker at his camp, about 415 m east of Muirne
steps.text: The Broker falls among his carts. His ledger lists every load: from the sheevra, through the hollow, to 'the Voice, in the Wicker Fields of Connacht'.

steps.goal: Bring the broker's ledger to Muirne of the Rowan, about 350 m south of Howth
steps.say:
The Wicker Fields. The Voice of the Azure himself.

The trail leaves our valley here. I'm sending this to Druidess Eabha in Ardee - the Rowan in Connacht will want it. And you, if you've the stomach for fire.
